user.title: Polish fuel prices GOV.PL
user.description: Add the integration that downloads maximum retail fuel prices published by the Polish Ministry of Energy on gov.pl. Data is checked automatically every 30 minutes.

abort.single_instance_allowed: This integration can only be configured once.

init.title: Ceny paliw GOV.PL configuration
init.description: Choose a configuration section. Changes are applied after selecting Save and finish.

menu_option_descriptions.notification_settings: Enable notifications, set the time and automatic delivery mode.
menu_option_descriptions.notification_content: Choose fuels and optionally customize the title or message.
menu_option_descriptions.notification_filters: Send only on price changes and set a minimum change in grosz.
menu_option_descriptions.phones: Add, remove and configure phones individually.
menu_option_descriptions.diagnostics: Check source status, history, phones and run manual actions.
menu_option_descriptions.save: Save all changes and reload the integration.

data_description.notifications_enabled: Master switch for automatic delivery. Manual buttons remain available.
data_description.notification_time: Time used by delivery modes with scheduled sending.
data_description.notification_mode: By default the integration sends at the selected time. If tomorrow's prices are not available yet, it waits and sends after publication is detected.

notification_content.title: Notification content and fuels
notification_content.description: Choose fuels. Empty template fields use the default content. Templates can use `today_date`, `tomorrow_date`, `published`, `pb95`, `pb98` and `on`. Each fuel exposes `today`, `tomorrow`, `today_text`, `tomorrow_text`, `change` and `difference_grosz`. Example: `{{ pb95.change }}`.

data_description.notification_fuels: PB95, PB98 and diesel are included by default.
data_description.notification_custom_title: Supports Home Assistant templates. Leave empty to use the default title.
data_description.notification_custom_message: Supports Home Assistant templates. Leave empty to use the default message with prices and changes.

notification_filters.title: Price change filters
notification_filters.description: You can limit automatic messages to days when selected fuels changed price.

data.notification_only_on_change: Send only when the price changes

data_description.notification_only_on_change: If none of the selected fuels match the condition, the message for that day is skipped.
data_description.notification_min_change_grosz: The threshold is used when change-only delivery is enabled. A value of 0 means any change greater than 0gr.

phones.title: Phones
phones.description: Configured phones: {count}. Each phone can be edited separately.

menu_option_descriptions.phone_list: Edit the list of phones available to this integration.
menu_option_descriptions.choose_phone: Choose one phone and open its individual submenu.
menu_option_descriptions.init: Return to the main configuration menu.

phone_list.title: Phone list
phone_list.description: Select phones registered by the Home Assistant Companion app. You can edit this list later.

data_description.notification_services: Adding a phone does not force automatic delivery. Each phone has its own switch in its submenu.

choose_phone.title: Choose phone
choose_phone.description: Choose the phone you want to configure.

phone_menu.title: Phone: {device}
phone_menu.description: Home Assistant target: `{target}`. Automatic delivery to this phone: {enabled}. Last action: {status}

menu_option_descriptions.phone_settings: Change the phone name and enable or disable automatic notifications.
menu_option_descriptions.phone_test: Immediately send a short test notification only to this phone.
menu_option_descriptions.phone_send_now: Immediately send this phone a message in the same format as the daily notification.
menu_option_descriptions.choose_phone: Go directly to another phone configuration.

phone_settings.title: Phone settings: {device}
phone_settings.description: Home Assistant target: `{target}`. Manual test and current notification actions are available in the phone submenu.

data.device_enabled: Send automatic notifications to this phone

data_description.device_name: Enter a custom name or keep the default name.
data_description.device_enabled: When disabled, the phone remains on the list but is skipped for daily automatic notifications.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics and actions
diagnostics.description: Tomorrow price: **{tomorrow_status}**. Last fetch: `{fetched_at}`. Parsed publications: **{parsed_periods}**. Stored history days: **{history_days}**. Last error: **{last_error}**. Missing notification targets: **{missing_targets}**. Last action: **{action_status}**.

menu_option_descriptions.diagnostics_refresh: Immediately check gov.pl and refresh entities.
menu_option_descriptions.diagnostics_send_all: Send the current daily message to all enabled phones.
menu_option_descriptions.init: Return to the main configuration menu.

options.on_publication: Immediately after new prices are published
options.scheduled_then_publication: At the configured time, or immediately after publication if prices are not available yet (default)

parser_error.title: Fuel prices cannot be parsed from gov.pl
parser_error.description: The integration downloaded gov.pl but could not parse fuel price publications. The page layout may have changed. Last error: `{error}`. Check for an integration update or report the problem in the repository.

notification_target_missing.title: Notification phone is unavailable
notification_target_missing.description: Configured phone **{name}** uses target `{target}`, which Home Assistant does not currently provide. Open the integration configuration and select the current phone or disable automatic delivery for this entry.
